whoWeAre.heading: 1. Who We Are
whoWeAre.intro: {{companyName}} (registry code: {{registryCode}}), registered address {{contactAddress}}, is the data controller responsible for the personal data collected through this website (estoria.estate).

dataWeCollect.heading: 2. Data We Collect
dataWeCollect.intro: We collect personal data in the following situations:
items: Contact form — name, email address, phone number (optional), and your message. Lawful basis: your consent / legitimate interest in responding to your inquiry.
Property inquiry — same as contact form, plus a reference to the property you are enquiring about.
Newsletter subscription — email address and preferred language. Lawful basis: your explicit consent.
dataWeCollect.note: We do not collect sensitive personal data (health, financial, or identity documents) through this website.

howWeUse.heading: 3. How We Use Your Data
items: Responding to your contact or property enquiry
Sending newsletter emails you have subscribed to
Improving our services based on the enquiries we receive
howWeUse.note: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

retention.heading: 4. Data Retention
retention.body: Contact and inquiry messages are retained for up to 3 years from the date of submission, after which they are deleted. Newsletter subscriptions are retained until you unsubscribe.

rights.heading: 5. Your Rights Under GDPR
rights.intro: As a data subject you have the right to:
items: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure — request deletion of your data
Restriction — ask us to pause processing your data
Portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format
Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interest
Withdraw consent — unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time
rights.contactBefore: To exercise any of these rights, email us at

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies
cookies.body: This website uses only technically necessary cookies required for basic functionality (e.g. language preference). We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

complaints.heading: 7. Complaints
complaints.before: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon) at
complaints.after: if you believe we are processing your data unlawfully.
